results.title: Before AI Can Understand Property, Property Needs Better Data
results.description: Real estate technology has improved enormously over the past two decades, but much of that progress has happened at the surface. Listings moved online. Photography improved. Maps became interactive. Filters became more precise. Mobile apps made it possible to search for a home from almost anywhere. All of this made property discovery easier. But... results.title: Colorado lawmakers call for new AI safeguards as fears over catastrophic risks grow
results.description: Colorado lawmakers push for AI safeguards with bipartisan backing, as Rep. Brittany Pettersen says the technology now scares her more than Donald Trump. Proposals include mandatory incident reporting, independent audits, and a new federal oversight agency.
